qb_inactive_ownership.what_true_does_not_mean: it does not mean no quarterback is inactive, and it does not mean the projection is right. It means the inactive evidence was consumed by the mechanism that owns the share.
qb_inactive_ownership.what_true_means: the official list for BOTH clubs was ingested and tied to this game, every officially inactive quarterback the model carries was excluded from the allocation BEFORE the draw, no official name went unresolved, the shares close, and the forecast was built from this allocation.
